info.title: Tigrify Backend API
info.description: Full-featured Backend REST API with Swagger documentation for Tigrify platform. Eliminates direct client-side database access from JavaScript and securely handles all CRUD operations for Users, Lessons, Streams, Messages, and Interactions.
